recaps.title: Week 7 Recap: Doubtpfizer Prints 311.5, Goats Off the Bus by 2, Four-Way Logjam at 5-2
recaps.coldOpen: Week 7 in the WU had a 60-point linebacker, a 53-point linebacker, and a bus decided by two points. Kyle’s Doubtpfizer dropped the week’s high at 311.5 behind Alex Singleton’s 53 and took the kitty. Jacob Crisp’s Hyper got 60 from Blake Cashman, the biggest game since Devin Lloyd’s 66 back in Week 2, and handed Pocket its second loss. Mike Heff’s Goats lost to Saltese 208.5–203.5, and that 203.5 was the low among the alive, so the Goats are off the bus and seven teams remain. Bill’s Eddies made it five straight with a 205.5 that cleared the bus by exactly two points. Gavin’s Dongers finally got win number one with a 278, and on Last Ride, Chase’s TTAB put up 255.5, sent Saltese home for good, and climbed into the driver’s seat. Pocket, the Eddies, LAB and the Goats are all 5-2. Hero of the week: Doubtpfizer at 311.5 and two straight wins. Goat of the week: the Goats, who lost the game, the bus seat and a share of first place on one 5-point scoreboard.

matchups.scoreline: Mrs. Doubtpfizer 311.5, Towner Top Aga Bottom 255.5
matchups.blurb: Kyle’s Doubtpfizer posted the fourth 300-point week of the season, and it wasn’t close. **Alex Singleton’s 53** led a **178** IDP unit, the best defense in the league by 35, with **Nakobe Dean’s 30**, **DeMarvion Overshown’s 30**, **Kamari Lassiter’s 26** and **Byron Young’s 19** piling on. **Dak Prescott’s 28**, **Braelon Allen’s 27**, **Colston Loveland’s 24.5** and **CMC’s 22** kept the offense honest at **133.5**. Chase’s TTAB actually won the offense **154.5–133.5** behind **Bo Nix’s 40**, **Javonte Williams’ 30**, **Emanuel Wilson’s 27** and **Jameson Williams’ 26**, then watched the defense post **101**. TTAB’s **255.5** is the best losing score of the week, and it still counted for something on Last Ride. Doubtpfizer climbs to **3-4** with **1782.5** PF, second-most in the league. Juice: Singleton 53; the kitty; two straight. Junk: **Nico Collins’ 2**, **Elijah Ponder’s 2** and **Nik Bonitto’s 3**, plus Bo Nix’s 40 in an L (TTAB cut him Monday night anyway).

Gavin’s Dongers are officially on the board. After six weeks of nothing, the offense went for **160**, the best in the league: **Tony Pollard’s 44**, **JSN’s 37**, **Joe Burrow’s 36** and **T.J. Hockenson’s 16**, with **Christian Elliss’ 33** and **Xavier McKinney’s 20** on defense. Jesse’s LAB won the IDP **143–118** behind **Quay Walker’s 31**, **Drue Tranquill’s 23**, **Minkah Fitzpatrick’s 22** and **Aidan Hutchinson’s 21**, but **103.5** on offense couldn’t keep up. **Jaylen Warren’s 24** and **Puka Nacua’s 21** were the best of it. LAB drops to **5-2**; the Dongers go to **1-6** with the second-best score of the week. Juice: Pollard/JSN/Burrow; win number one. Junk: **Isaiah Likely’s 4.5**, **Tyler Allgeier’s 8** and **Carnell Tate’s 10** for LAB; the Dongers waiting until Week 7 to do this.

matchups.scoreline: Ultron 269.5, Newman Lake Sleep Paralysis Demons 236
matchups.blurb: Brian Aga’s Ultron got two linebackers to play like a whole defense. **Kendal Daniels’ 44** and **Micah McFadden’s 36** led a **136** IDP, and **Caleb Williams’ 31**, **Ashton Jeanty’s 22**, **D’Andre Swift’s 21** and **Drake London’s 19** gave the offense **133.5**. Oh, and **Rhamondre Stevenson’s 22**, the same Stevenson the Eddies shipped out for Bryce Young, who scored 9 this week. Ryan McCallum’s SPD’s got **Zay Flowers’ 33**, **Tee Higgins’ 32** and **Henry To’oTo’o’s 31**, and lost anyway. Ultron goes to **3-4**; the SPD’s drop to **3-4** but stay on the bus at **236**. Juice: Daniels/McFadden; Stevenson’s revenge game. Junk: **Juwan Johnson’s 2** (SPD’s TE slot is a crime scene), **A.J. Brown’s 7** and **Treydan Stukes’ 5** (dropped Monday).

Jacob Crisp’s Hyper finally got the record to match the points, and it took a historic linebacker game to do it. **Blake Cashman’s 60** is the biggest single-player score since Devin Lloyd’s 66 in Week 2, and **Nick Bolton’s 27** and **Payton Wilson’s 23** helped build a **140** IDP. **Amon-Ra St. Brown’s 30**, **Luther Burden’s 29** and **Kirk Cousins’ 23** handled the offense. Kellen’s Pocket got **Trey McBride’s 40**, the top tight end of the week, plus **Jared Goff’s 27** and **CeeDee Lamb’s 24**, but the defense managed only **111**. Pocket still leads the league in PF at **1940**, but drops to **5-2** and gets pulled into the four-way tie. Hyper goes to **3-4** with **1771.5** PF. Juice: Cashman 60; Hyper beating the PF leader. Junk: **Will Anderson Jr.’s 5** for the second straight week, **Sam LaPorta’s 3**, **Jalen Carter’s 3** and **Jaylin Noel’s 5**.

Nate’s Substation won it on defense and moved into fifth alone. **Jack Campbell’s 26** and **Tykee Smith’s 26** led a **114** IDP, and **Malik Nabers’ 24**, **RJ Harvey’s 19**, **Ja’Marr Chase’s 17** and **Tucker Kraft’s 17** gave the offense **108**. Ryan Towner’s Slumlords actually won the offense **110–108** behind **Drake Maye’s 35**, **Jahmyr Gibbs’ 25** and **Quinshon Judkins’ 24**, but the defense that put up 160 last week fell all the way to **85**: **Budda Baker’s 3**, **Devon Witherspoon’s 6** and **Maxx Crosby’s 11**. The Slumlords’ **195** was the second-lowest score of the week. Substation goes to **4-3**; the Slumlords drop to **3-4**. Juice: Campbell/Smith; Substation alone at 4-3. Junk: **Kalif Raymond’s 0**, the Slumlords’ 85 defense, and **Germie Bernard’s 5** for Nate.

Luke’s Saltese won the game and lost Last Ride on the same afternoon, and the Goats lost the game and their bus seat on the same scoreboard. **Jamien Sherwood’s 29**, **Tre Tucker’s 27**, **Matthew Stafford’s 22** and **Dre Greenlaw’s 22** got Saltese to **208.5**, with a **123** defense doing the work. Mike Heff’s Goats got **Bucky Irving’s 32**, **Quincy Williams’ 32**, **Keisean Nixon’s 22** and **Josh Jacobs’ 20**, but **Patrick Mahomes’ 4**, **Derrick Henry’s 7** and **DK Metcalf’s 7** sank the offense to **98.5**. The Goats’ **203.5** was the lowest score among the alive, so they’re off the bus. Saltese goes to **3-4**; the Goats fall to **5-2**. Juice: Sherwood/Tucker; Saltese winning a 5-point grinder. Junk: Mahomes’ 4, **Julian Love’s 2**, **Aaron Jones’ 4** and **Tyler Higbee’s 4.5**.

matchups.scoreline: Eagle Ridge Eddies 205.5, Morningside Muff Divers 192.5
matchups.blurb: Bill’s Eddies made it five straight, and they did it the hard way. The offense scored **68.5**, and the defense carried the rest: **Fred Warner’s 33**, **Jordyn Brooks’ 23**, **Evan Williams’ 20**, **Tyrice Knight’s 19** and **Quentin Lake’s 18** built a **137** IDP. **Cameron Skattebo’s 27** and **Brock Bowers’ 17.5** were the only real offense. Tim’s Divers got **Bobby Okereke’s 31**, **Jessie Bates’ 29**, **Ollie Gordon’s 26** and **Demetrius Knight’s 23**, but their receivers went **Addison 4 / Jefferson 8 / Keenan Allen 8 / Worthy 4**. The Eddies’ **205.5** cleared the bus by exactly **2** points over the Goats. Eddies go to **5-2**, second on the tiebreak with **1744** PF; Morningside’s **192.5** is the week floor, and they drop to **3-4**. Juice: Warner 33; five straight; still on the bus. Junk: **Jalen Coker’s 1**, **Kendrick Bourne’s 3**, **Garrett Wilson’s 4** and **Bryce Young’s 9** (see Ultron for Stevenson’s 22).

Last Ride: Saltese is out for good, TTAB takes over, and Week 8 is TTAB vs the Goats. Pocket, the Eddies, LAB and the Goats are all 5-2, the Dongers have a win, and nobody is safe. WWJDD: start your linebackers, never trust a 205.5 to keep you on the bus, and check whether the guy you traded away is about to drop 22 on you.

recaps.title: Week 6 Recap: Pocket Steals the Kitty by 3.5, Goats Survive by 3, TTAB Off the Bus
recaps.coldOpen: Week 6 in the WU was decided by the width of a chip. Kellen’s Pocket Agents took the kitty at 262.5 and needed every bit of it, because Luke’s Saltese dropped a 259 and still lost by 3.5. Mike Heff’s Goats beat Chase’s TTAB 189.5–186.5 in the ugliest game of the week, and that same 3-point margin decided the bus: TTAB’s 186.5 was the low among the alive, so Chase is off and eight teams remain. The Eddies made it four straight behind Trevor Lawrence’s 40 and a 152-point defense. On Last Ride, Saltese’s 259 buried Ultron’s 205.5, so Brian is out for good and Luke lives again. Pocket, LAB and the Goats share 5-1, and Gavin’s Dongers are 0-6 after the week’s floor of 163. Hero of the week: Pocket at 262.5 and a 1706 PF that’s now 167.5 clear of the field. Goat of the week: TTAB losing the game and the bus seat on one 3-point scoreboard.

matchups.blurb: Kellen “the Host” Olson took the kitty with the smallest cushion of the week. **Amani Hooker’s 36**, **Tyler Shough’s 32**, **Ernest Jones’ 27**, **Josiah Trotter’s 27** and **Cooper DeJean’s 23** carried a **262.5**, with **Rashid Shaheed’s 20** and **Trey McBride’s 19.5** doing the skill work. Luke’s Saltese threw everything back: **Jamien Sherwood’s 34**, **JSN’s 31** (still the OMVP leader at **197** YTD), **Tre Tucker’s 26** and **Jevon Holland’s 26**, and won the defense **144–138**. It still came up **3.5** short, and **259** is the best losing score of the week. Pocket goes to **5-1** with **1706** PF. Saltese falls to **2-4** on the board, but that same 259 cruised on Last Ride. Juice: Hooker/Shough; Pocket’s third kitty of the year. Junk: **Will Anderson Jr.’s 2**, which cost him the DMVP lead; **Denzel Boston’s 2**; Saltese’s 259 in an L.

The Eddies made it four straight, and the defense did the heavy lifting. **George Karlaftis’ 35**, **Quentin Lake’s 25**, **Evan Williams’ 25**, **Tyrice Knight’s 20**, **Fred Warner’s 17** and **Trenton Simpson’s 16** built a **152** IDP unit, the second-best of the week. **Trevor Lawrence’s 40** led all offensive players, with **Chimere Dike’s 16** and **Jalen Coker’s 15** chipping in. Nate’s Substation actually won the offense **130.5–107.5** behind **Malik Nabers’ 36**, **Germie Bernard’s 25** and **Nick Emmanwori’s 25**, but the IDP managed only **97**. Eddies go to **4-2**, second in PF at **1538.5**; Substation drops to **3-3**. Juice: Lawrence 40, Karlaftis 35, four straight. Junk: **Rhamondre Stevenson’s 5** (now Ultron’s problem in the Bryce Young swap); **Garrett Wilson’s 8**; Substation’s **97** defense.

Kyle’s Doubtpfizer finally got the whole roster to show up on the same Sunday. **Christian McCaffrey’s 31**, **Chuba Hubbard’s 29** and **Colston Loveland’s 22** gave the offense **123**, and **Alex Singleton 29 / Sonny Styles 29 / Nakobe Dean 25** pushed the IDP to **132**. Dean now leads the DMVP race at **163** YTD. Jacob Crisp’s Hyper got **Kenneth Walker III’s 35**, **Jaylin Noel’s 32**, **Travis Hunter’s 28** and **Jeremy Chinn’s 26**, and a **237** that wins most weeks. Hyper has the league’s third-best PF (**1519.5**) and a **2-4** record to show for it. Doubtpfizer climbs to **2-4** too. Juice: CMC/Hubbard; Dean’s DMVP lead. Junk: **Darren Waller’s 0** (dropped Monday night), **Justin Herbert’s 7**, **Josh Hines-Allen’s 3** and **Abdul Carter’s 1**.

matchups.scoreline: Indian Trail Slumlords 249.5, Morningside Muff Divers 212.5

Mike Heff’s Goats won it with **George Kittle’s 20.5**, **DK Metcalf’s 20** and **Quincy Williams’ 21**, while **Patrick Mahomes posted an 8**, **Derrick Henry a 5**, **Bucky Irving an 8**, and **T.J. recaps.title: Week 5 Recap: LAB Prints 299.5, Eddies Hit 298, Goats Finally Blink
recaps.coldOpen: Week 5 in the WU: Jesse’s Little Ass Boys dropped a 299.5 kitty built on a 231.5 offense, The Eddies punched in a 298 for a third straight W, and Mike Heff’s Goats finally lost — Hyper took them 235–213 with T.J. Watt on the board for a clean zero. Pocket survived Gavin’s Dongers 287–280 in the week’s street fight, Ultron’s 207 was the low among the alive and walked them off the bus, and on Last Ride Luke’s Saltese (209) edged Tim’s Divers (203) so Morningside is out for good. Three teams sit at 4-1 (Pocket, LAB, Goats). Dongers are still looking for a first win at 0-5. Hero of the week: LAB at 299.5 (Warren 56 / Puka 42 / Likely 40.5 / Daniels 38). Goat of the week: Watt’s goose egg in the Goats’ first L, and Ultron’s ticket off the bus.

Same 203 lost Last Ride to Saltese by 6, so the Divers are out of re-entry for good. Juice: Warren/Puka/Likely/Daniels; LAB to **4-1** with the week’s high mark. Junk: **Roman Wilson’s 0**; Morningside taking two L’s off one scoreboard.

The Eddies made it three straight the loud way. The offense finally showed up for **170** behind **Trevor Lawrence’s 36**, **Brock Bowers’ 34.5**, **Garrett Wilson’s 29** and **Tyler Warren’s 26.5**, and the IDP unit still added **128** with **Evan Williams 28**, **Fred Warner 25** and **Trenton Simpson 25**. Kellen “the Host” Olson almost got cooked. Pocket’s offense was quiet (**99**) with **CeeDee Lamb at 2** and **Jaylen Waddle at 3**, but the IDP unit went nuclear for **188**: **Will Anderson Jr. 37**, **Barrett Carter 34**, **Cooper DeJean 30**, **Ernest Jones 30**. Goff’s **34** and **Trey McBride’s 27.5** kept the lights on. Pocket to **4-1** with the league’s top PF (**1443.5**). Dongers are **0-5** with another quality loss. Juice: Pocket’s 188 defense; Anderson’s 37. Junk: CeeDee’s 2; another Dongers smash that still ends in an L.

recaps.title: Week 4 Recap: Pocket Prints 361, Saltese Off the Bus, Goats Alone at 4-0
recaps.coldOpen: Week 4 in the WU: Kellen’s Pocket Agents dropped a 361 that is the biggest number of 2026 by almost forty points, Luke’s Saltese posted the week’s floor at 206.5 and walked off the bus, and Ryan Towner’s Slumlords pulled the rarest double: lost to the Eddies and got bounced off Last Ride in the same weekend. Mike Heff’s Goats are still the only unbeaten team at 4-0. Four teams sit at 3-1 behind him, and Gavin’s Dongers are still looking for a first W at 0-4. Hero of the week: Pocket at 361 (McMillan 51 / CeeDee 47 / Ernest Jones 45). Goat of the week: Saltese’s 206.5, and the Slumlords for losing two games on one scoreboard.

matchups.blurb: Kellen “the Host” Olson didn’t win this one, he audited it. **Tetairoa McMillan’s 51** and **CeeDee Lamb’s 47** turned the offense into a **169** wall, **Jared Goff added 34**, and then the IDP unit showed up like it was getting paid by the tackle: **Ernest Jones 45**, with **Will Anderson Jr., Barrett Carter and Foyesade Oluokun at 29 apiece**, for a **192** defense. That’s **361**, the second kitty of the year for Pocket and the new season high. Kyle’s Doubtpfizer did nothing wrong. **Nico Collins’ 36**, **Chuba Hubbard’s 33**, **Alex Singleton’s 33** and **Dak’s 25** added up to **268.5**, the fifth-best score of the week, and it lost by **92.5**. Juice: McMillan/CeeDee/Jones all 45-plus; Pocket to 3-1 with the league’s top PF (1156.5). Junk: **Dalton Kincaid’s 1.5** (again); Doubtpfizer at 1-3 with a number that beats nine teams this week.

Nate’s Substation finally got the IDP math to work for him instead of against him. The secondary went nuclear with **Nick Emmanwori 38** and **Christian Izien 34**, **Tremaine Edmunds added 34**, and the defense closed at **172**. **Malik Nabers’ 29** and **RJ Harvey’s 25** handled the offense. Chase’s TTAB actually matched them on offense (**123 to 123.5**) behind **Javonte Williams 33** and **Emanuel Wilson 31**, then the defense clocked in for **93**. **Jeremiah Trotter’s 37** carried that unit alone, while **Andrew Wingard and Andre Cisco went 2 apiece**. **Josh Allen managed 19**. TTAB has dropped two straight since the Week 1 kitty and sits at 2-2. Juice: Substation’s 172 defense; Emmanwori/Izien/Edmunds all 34+. Junk: Wingard and Cisco at 2; TTAB’s defense losing by 79.

Heff’s Goats went to **4-0** on defense this time. **Arvell Reese dropped 40**, **T.J. Watt added 33**, and **Drake Thomas 25 / Devin Lloyd 23** pushed the IDP unit to **147**. **George Kittle’s 25.5** led the offense. Brian Aga’s Ultron got real juice from **Kyle Monangai (37)** and **Bryce Young (31)**, and **Jack Campbell 27 / Dallas Turner 26** kept the defense honest. Then you get to the big names: **Saquon Barkley 1**, **Ja’Marr Chase 5**, **Jaishawn Barham 2**. Ultron is 1-3. Juice: Goats alone at 4-0; Reese’s 40 and Watt’s 33. Junk: Saquon’s 1; Chase’s 5; 225 with two 30-burgers still losing by 55.5.

Jesse’s LAB went to **3-1** with an offense that hit **161**. **Kyren Williams (40)**, **Puka Nacua (33)** and **C.J. Stroud (32)** did the work, and **Demario Davis’ 31** led the defense. Jacob Crisp’s Hyper got **Kenneth Walker III’s 39**, which made him the OMVP leader at **142** YTD, plus **Jacob Rodriguez 36** and **Sam LaPorta 28.5**. Then **Kenyon Sadiq went from 34.5 last week to 0** and **Emeka Egbuka added 3**. Hyper is 1-3 with the league’s second-most points (1047.5). Juice: Kyren/Puka/Stroud; LAB to 3-1. Junk: Sadiq’s goose egg; Hyper’s PF-rich, win-poor season.

matchups.scoreline: Newman Lake Sleep Paralysis Demons 226.5, Drummond Dongers 215
matchups.blurb: Rymo’s SPD’s won a tight one the WR way. **Tee Higgins went for 32**, **Zay Flowers 31** and **Jonathan Taylor 24**, and **Nathan Landman, fresh off the Saltese trade, chipped in 21** on defense. That’s 3-1. Gavin’s Dongers had the best top end on the field: **Bijan Robinson 41**, **Joe Burrow 35**, **Kyle Hamilton 26**, **Chris Olave 25** and **Brenton Strange 22**. Then the flex room turned in **Ladd McConkey 0, Parker Washington 1 and D.J. Moore 2**, three points from three starters in an 11.5-point loss. Dongers are 0-4. Juice: Higgins/Flowers; SPD’s at 3-1. Junk: McConkey/Washington/Moore combining for 3; another big Bijan week in an L.

matchups.scoreline: Eagle Ridge Eddies 226, Indian Trail Slumlords 218.5
matchups.blurb: The Eddies made it two straight wins, and the defense did it again. **Evan Williams 36**, **Jordyn Brooks 27**, **Mack Wilson 21** and **Fred Warner 20** gave the IDP unit **131**, and **Brian Robinson Jr.’s 27** and **Brock Bowers’ 25.5** carried an offense that only managed 95. **Garrett Wilson 5** and **Leonard Williams 1** were along for the ride. Ryan Towner’s Slumlords got **Drake Maye’s 30** (from 1 last week), **Quinshon Judkins 23**, **Budda Baker 23**, and **19 each from Jahmyr Gibbs and DMVP leader Gregory Rousseau** (137 YTD), and fell **7.5** short. Worse, 218.5 also lost the Last Ride game to Morningside by 5, so the Slumlords are out of re-entry for good. Juice: Eddies to 2-2; Evan Williams’ 36. Junk: Slumlords taking two Ls off one score; Leonard Williams’ 1.

Tim’s Divers got kicked off the bus last week and won twice this week. **C.J. Henderson’s 34**, **Ollie Gordon’s 25**, **Isaiah Williams’ 23**, **Lamar’s 22** and **Deebo’s 21** beat Saltese, moved Morningside to **3-1**, and the same 223.5 kept them alive on Last Ride over the Slumlords. Luke’s Saltese got **Edgerrin Cooper 34** and **Jamien Sherwood 32** on defense, plus **Carnell Tate’s 26**. The offense was the problem: **JSN 12**, **Stafford 13**, **David Montgomery 4**, **Mason Graham 0**. At **206.5**, Saltese had the lowest score in the league and is off the bus. Week 5 Last Ride is Morningside vs Saltese, and the loser is out for good. Juice: Divers’ double win; Cooper/Sherwood. Junk: 206.5 week floor; JSN’s 12; Saltese’s second straight L.

heroes: Pocket 361: McMillan 51 / CeeDee 47 / Ernest Jones 45; season-high kitty, Pocket’s second
Substation’s 172 defense: Emmanwori 38 / Izien 34 / Edmunds 34
Goats 4-0: Reese 40 / Watt 33; still the only unbeaten team
Kenneth Walker III 39: takes the OMVP lead at 142 YTD
Morningside’s double: beat Saltese and stayed alive on Last Ride
Eddies to 2-2: Evan Williams 36 / Brooks 27 / B-Rob 27
goats: Saltese 206.5: week floor, off the bus; JSN 12 / Montgomery 4 / Graham 0
Slumlords: lost to the Eddies and out of Last Ride on the same 218.5
Dongers flex room: McConkey 0 / Washington 1 / Moore 2 in an 11.5-point loss; 0-4
Saquon 1 / Chase 5: Ultron’s big names go quiet
Sadiq 0 (from 34.5) and Kincaid 1.5
recaps.closer: Kitty to Pocket at 361, the high mark of the season. Saltese is off the bus with 206.5, and 10 teams are still alive. Last Ride: Morningside stays alive and the Slumlords are done; Week 5 is Morningside vs Saltese. Heff is alone at 4-0, Pocket, SPD’s, LAB and Morningside are at 3-1, and the Dongers are still looking for a first win. WWJDD: start your studs, respect the linebackers, and don’t lose two games with one score.

recaps.title: Week 3 Recap: Slumlords Print 299, Hyper’s 281.5 Still an L, Divers Off the Bus
recaps.coldOpen: Week 3 in the WU: a 299 kitty from a team that started 0-2 and already rode the Survivor bus, a 281.5 that still loses, and a former 2-0 Divers board that bottomed out at 144 and walked off the bus. Ryan Towner’s Slumlords beat Jacob Crisp’s Hyper in a street fight, then stayed alive on Last Ride while Gavin’s Dongers got eliminated for good. Mike Heff’s Goats are the league’s only 3-0. Chase’s TTAB took its first L. Luke’s Saltese finally blinked. Hero of the week: Slumlords at 299 (Gibbs 42 / Fannin 29 / Cook 27) with a Maye ceremonial 1, plus that Last Ride stay-alive. Goat of the week: Morningside’s 144 — and a format that turns Hyper’s 281.5 into heartbreak.
heroes: Slumlords 299 — Gibbs 42 / Fannin 29 / Cook 27; Maye 1 punchline; week kitty + Last Ride stay-alive
Hyper’s 281.5 — quality-loss club with Sadiq 34.5; league-high PF, still 1-2
Goats 3-0 — Kittle 32 / Henry 24; sole undefeated
Eddies’ first W — Bowers 41.5 / Warner 41 / G. Wilson 32
SPD’s’ skill stack — Juwan 30.5 / Golden 27 / Adams 26; ended Saltese’s perfect start
Purdy 44 + London 36 (Sub) — nuclear skill half that still lost to Pocket IDP
goats: Morningside 144 — off the bus; Achane 1 / JJ 5 / Price −1
Dongers 0-3 — Bijan 44 wasted; out of Last Ride for good
TTAB 192 — Allen’s 15; first L after the Week 1 lottery
Maye’s 1 — ceremonial QB on a kitty winner
Gadsden 0 / Waddle 6 / Kincaid 3.5 — quiet hours across three otherwise grown-up cards

matchups.blurb: Ryan Towner did not ask for a soft landing after Weeks 1–2 — he ordered a **299** kitty. The punchline writes itself: **Drake Maye scored 1**, and the board still nuked the week on **Jahmyr Gibbs (42), Harold Fannin (29), and James Cook (27)** while the IDP unit printed a league-bully **176**. Jacob Crisp’s Hyper put up a very real **281.5** — season-long PF leader vibes — with **Kenyon Sadiq’s 34.5** and **Kenneth Walker’s 23**, and still left empty-handed. Same movie as Week 2’s quality-loss club, just with a higher price of admission. Juice: 299 kitty; Gibbs/Fannin/Cook triad; Last Ride still breathing. Junk: Maye’s 1; 281.5 as a losing number; Hyper to 1-2 with the league’s highest PF.

The Eddies cashed their first W of 2026 the IDP way. **Brock Bowers dropped 41.5**, **Fred Warner matched him with 41**, and **Garrett Wilson added 32** while the defense choir (Leonard Williams 21 / Jordyn Brooks 21 / Evan Williams 20) finished the job at **263.5**. Gavin’s Dongers brought **Bijan Robinson’s 44**, **Joe Burrow’s 27**, and **Chris Olave’s 25** — a skill stack that should buy wins — and still finished **224** and **0-3**. Worse: on Last Ride math (Slumlords 299 vs Dongers 224), Gavin is out of the re-entry path for good. Juice: Bowers/Warner twin towers; Eddies off the schneid. Junk: Bijan’s 44 in a funeral; Dongers’ Last Ride eviction.

matchups.scoreline: Newman Lake Sleep Paralysis Demons 263.5, Saltese Slamm 235
matchups.blurb: SPD’s ended Luke’s undefeated run with a skill-board crime spree. **Juwan Johnson’s 30.5**, **Matthew Golden’s 27**, **Davante Adams’ 26**, and **Tee Higgins’ 21** stacked a **142.5** offense and a **263.5** final. Luke’s Saltese still got **Jaxon Smith-Njigba’s 40** and **Matthew Stafford’s 25** — JSN leads the league OMVP board at 126 YTD — and watched **Oronde Gadsden post a zero** while the rest of the flex room stayed quiet-adjacent. Rookie franchise, first scar. Juice: SPD’s WR/TE explosion; Luke’s first L. Junk: Gadsden’s 0; 235 as a respectable loss that still stings.

Kyle’s dual-era champ finally cashed a W after the 0-2 hole. Doubtpfizer closed **265** behind **CMC’s 23**, **Dak’s 20**, and an IDP unit that outworked the skill gap (**157** defense). Brian Aga’s Ultron brought real juice — **Michael Wilson 25, Ja’Marr Chase 24, Terry McLaurin 19** — and still left at **240** with **Terrance Ferguson’s 2** as the sour TE note. Not a collapse. Just the champ remembering how to win ugly. Juice: Doubtpfizer off the schneid; CMC being CMC. Junk: Ferguson’s 2; Ultron stuck at 1-2.

Kellen “the Host” Olson won the IDP math olympiad. Pocket’s offense managed a modest **98.5** — **CeeDee 26 / Goff 22 / McBride 22**, with **Waddle at 6** and **Kincaid at 3.5** after last week’s TE party — while the defense printed **158** and dragged the board to **256.5**. Nate’s Substation threw **Brock Purdy’s 44** and **Drake London’s 36** at the problem and still could not survive a **91**-point IDP floor. That’s the week’s thesis in one box: forty-four from your QB is not a win if the other guy’s linebackers clock in. Juice: Pocket to 2-1 on IDP bullying. Junk: Purdy 44 / London 36 in an L; Waddle’s quiet encore.

matchups.scoreline: Little Ass Boys 239.5, Towner Top Aga Bottom 192
matchups.blurb: Jesse’s LAB ended Chase’s perfect start. **Jaylen Warren (27), Jeremiyah Love (24), and Kyren Williams (23)** did adult RB things while the IDP unit added **135** for a **239.5** close. Chase’s TTAB — Week 1 kitty kings — bottomed to **192** with **Josh Allen managing 15** (two picks and a fumble in the box) and a defense that only found **90**. **Christian Watson’s 22** showed up; the rest of the 315 hangover did not. Juice: LAB’s RB triad; TTAB’s first scar. Junk: Allen’s 15; Shakir’s 1 on the winning side as a free punchline; 192 from a former nuclear stack.

matchups.scoreline: Valley Old Goats 219, Morningside Muff Divers 144
matchups.blurb: Heff’s Goats went to **3-0** the professional way: **George Kittle’s 32** and **Derrick Henry’s 24** over Tim’s Divers in a game that was never a game. Divers posted the league floor at **144** — **Devon Achane 1, Justin Jefferson 5, Jadarian Price −1** — and got Survivor-eliminated after opening 2-0. **Deebo’s 28** and **Lamar’s 24** were lighthouses in a fog. Off the bus. Juice: Goats alone at 3-0; Kittle’s 32. Junk: 144 league floor; Achane/JJ/Price crime scene; a 2-0 start erased in one Tuesday.

recaps.closer: Kitty to Slumlords. League floor — and the Survivor bus — to Morningside. Hyper cracked 281 and still lost. Heff alone at 3-0. Luke and Chase both took their first scars. Eddies and Doubtpfizer cashed first wins. Last Ride: Slumlords stay alive; Dongers are done. WWJDD: start your studs, fear IDP math, and don’t confuse a 280 with a win.

recaps.title: Week 2 Recap: Host Hits 322, Lloyd’s 66, Three Boards Over 250 Still Lose
recaps.coldOpen: Week 2 in the WU: 158 is a crime scene, 322 is a new religion, and a good score is still an L if the other guy prints more. The Host dropped a kitty that made last week’s 315 look like a warm-up — and started Waddle for 27 after last week’s single. Three boards cracked 250 and still lost: Slumlords’ 252, Eddies’ 251.5, and Jacob’s Hyper at 272 in a seven-point street fight. Mike Heff’s Goats fed the league a 66-burger from Devin Lloyd. Luke stayed undefeated. The dual-era champ and the Dongers both woke up 0-2. Hero of the week: Pocket Agents at 322.5 (Goff 43 / CeeDee 41 / Will Anderson 39) and Lloyd’s 66. Goat of the week: Dongers’ 158.5, and a format that turns 250 into heartbreak three times in one Tuesday.
heroes: Pocket Agents 322.5 — Goff 43 / CeeDee 41 / Will Anderson 39; Waddle 27 revenge; week kitty
Devin Lloyd 66 (Goats) — IDP nuclear in a 274.5 over Eddies
JSN 54 (Saltese) — carried a 279–272 thriller; Luke 2-0
Davante Adams 47 (SPD’s) — from a Week 1 five to a beatdown of Doubtpfizer
Ultron’s first W — Hooker 30 / Cook 29 / Chase 26 after the W1 garage sale
goats: Dongers 158.5 — league floor; Goedert 1.5 on the other sideline still a W for TTAB
Quality-loss club — Slumlords 252, Eddies 251.5, Hyper 272 (all real boards, all Ls)
Doubtpfizer 213 — dual champ at 0-2 despite Dak 37 / Dean 32
LAB offense — Atwell 2; Davis-Gaither’s 32 carried a funeral to 182
Herbert 9 / TLaw 4 / Maye 6 — QB tax across three otherwise grown-up cards

matchups.blurb: The Host did not ask for a second chance — he ordered a nuclear stack. Kellen Olson’s Pocket Agents dropped a **322.5** kitty built on **Jared Goff (43), CeeDee Lamb (41), and Will Anderson Jr. (39)**, then twisted the knife with the punchline of the week: **Jaylen Waddle scored 27** after last week’s flex single. Add **Dalton Kincaid 28** and **Trey McBride 23.5** and you’ve got a TE room that could bully half the league by itself. Ryan Towner’s Slumlords — already Survivor Week 1 alumni — still posted a very real **252**. **Dalton Schultz 41** and **Budda Baker 38** showed up; **Drake Maye managed 6** and London stayed quiet-adjacent at **11**. In any other matchup that 252 buys you a win column. Against 322.5 it’s a footnote with a pulse — the same cruel math that also ate Eddies’ 251.5 and Hyper’s 272. Juice: 322.5; the Goff/CeeDee/Anderson triad; Waddle’s redemption arc. Junk: Maye’s 6; a 252 that wins most weeks and still looks like heartbreak.

matchups.scoreline: Valley Old Goats 274.5, Eagle Ridge Eddies 251.5
matchups.blurb: Heff’s Goats closed **274.5** behind a headline that needs no adjective: **Devin Lloyd dropped 66**. Sixty-six. On IDP. **Patrick Mahomes added 40** while **T.J. Watt (21)** kept the defense honest. The Eddies put up a real **251.5** — an IDP choir of **Evan Williams 34, Quentin Lake 28, Leonard Williams 27, Dorian Williams 27** — and still left empty-handed, with **Trevor Lawrence’s ceremonial 4** as the sour note on an otherwise grown-up card. Same movie as Slumlords and Hyper this week: you scored enough to win most matchups and still took the L. Juice: Lloyd’s 66; Mahomes’ 40; Goats to 2-0. Junk: TLaw’s 4; another 250+ that tastes like a loss.

Seven points. Rookie franchise vs the commissioner. Luke’s Saltese stayed **2-0** at **279**, powered by **Jaxon Smith-Njigba’s 54**, with **Matthew Stafford (40), DeVonta Smith (35), and Edgerrin Cooper (35)** stacking the rest of the crime. Jacob Crisp’s Hyper put up a very grown-up **272** — **Amon-Ra St. Brown 41, Kenneth Walker 32**, plus a **Nick Bolton / Blake Cashman 30–30** IDP tandem — and still walked away empty because **Justin Herbert managed 9**. That’s the week’s thesis in one box: 272 is a win most Tuesdays, and this Tuesday it joined Slumlords’ 252 and Eddies’ 251.5 in the quality-loss club. Jacob’s Week 1 Monday heist met Week 2’s reality check. Juice: JSN’s 54; Luke undefeated. Junk: Herbert’s 9; 272 as a losing number; the seven-point scar.

matchups.scoreline: Newman Lake Sleep Paralysis Demons 261, Mrs. Doubtpfizer 213
matchups.blurb: Rymo remembered how WR1s are supposed to work. After **Davante Adams’ Week 1 five-spot**, SPD’s printed **261** with **Adams’ 47** and **Jonathan Taylor’s 32**, plus **Azeez Al-Shaair’s 25** on IDP for the encore. Kyle Weberg’s dual-era champ landed at **213** — **Dak Prescott 37** and **Nakobe Dean 32** were real punches, **CMC 23** was fine — and it’s still **0-2**. Not a Dongers-zone collapse. Just ugly for a franchise that usually loses cute. Juice: Adams’ revenge 47; JT’s 32; SPD’s back to .500. Junk: champ résumé, 0-2 reality.

Tim’s Divers went to **2-0** the unspectacular way: **215** over Nate’s Substation **171**. **Travis Kelce (39)** did adult TE things while **Bobby Okereke (28)** and **Byron Young (23)** handled the IDP math — even with **Justin Jefferson at 8** and **Deebo at 8** ghosting the skill board. Substation got **Brock Purdy’s 32** and still could not drag **Alec Pierce (2)** and **David Montgomery (4)** across the line. After Week 1’s statement, Morningside just collected. Juice: Divers quietly perfect; Kelce’s 39. Junk: Pierce’s 2; Monty’s 4; Sub’s 171.

Chase’s TTAB stayed **2-0** without needing another 315 — just **Josh Allen’s 47**, **Dee Winters’ 26**, and **Caleb Downs’ 22** clearing a very low bar, even with **Dallas Goedert’s 1.5** as the trade hangover punchline. Gavin’s Dongers bottomed the league at **158.5**. **Kyle Hamilton (32), Bijan (24), and Olave (22)** showed up; the rest of the board did not. After blowing a Week 1 lead on Monday, Week 2 was a flatline. Allen alone outscored the vibe. Juice: TTAB 2-0 on Allen and IDP. Junk: 158.5 league floor; Goedert’s 1.5; Dongers 0-2 with nothing cute about it.

Aga’s first Wheels Up win of 2026, and it was an IDP heist. Ultron’s offense managed **78.5** — **Caleb Williams 6**, **Loveland 1.5**, **Quentin Johnston 1** — while the defense printed **122** and **Amani Hooker (30)** headlined the rescue. **James Cook (29)** and **Ja’Marr Chase (26)** finally showed up after the Week 1 garage-sale tape. Jesse’s LAB hit **182** with **Akeem Davis-Gaither’s 32** and **Quay Walker’s 23** carrying an offense that featured **Tutu Atwell for 2**. That’s a win for Ultron’s identity and a warning label for LAB’s skill slots. Juice: Hooker’s 30; Cook/Chase bounce-back; Aga to 1-1. Junk: Caleb’s 6; Atwell’s 2; winning ugly on defense.

recaps.closer: Kitty to Pocket. League floor to Dongers. Three teams cracked 250 and still lost — Slumlords 252, Eddies 251.5, Hyper 272. Luke 2-0 by seven. Heff’s Lloyd dropped 66. Adams remembered how to WR1. Waddle scored 27. Aga finally cashed a W on Hooker’s IDP. WWJDD: start your studs, fear linebackers named Lloyd, and don’t confuse a 250 with a win.

recaps.title: Week 1 Recap: TTAB Hits the Lottery, Jacob’s First Win, Slumlords Get Off the Bus
recaps.dateLabel: Tuesday drop · Week 1 finals locked after MNF
recaps.coldOpen: Welcome back to the WU, where 220 is a Tuesday, 315 is a war crime, and Monday night still flips scoreboards like a light switch. Week 1’s thesis was simple: premium draft capital does not equal points, Fantrax IDP math is a rumor, and the only board that mattered was the one still alive after Monday. We got a kitty jackpot, a Survivor eviction, Jacob Crisp’s first Wheels Up win, and enough goose eggs from “safe” stars to stock a diner. Hero of the week: whoever waited until after MNF to write the recap — and T.J. Watt’s 52. Goat of the week: Fantrax projections, Aga’s top-3, and the Host’s Waddle flex.
heroes: TTAB’s 315 — Allen 45 / Watson 44 / Jeanty 41 / Baun 35; kitty locked
Jacob Crisp’s first WU win — Hyper 259.5 over Dongers 246.5 (Monday heist; Walker 48)
T.J. Watt 52 (Goats) — half-century IDP and a 254 close
Gesicki 23 (Saltese) — no-name TE beat Bill’s premium room
goats: Slumlords 176.5 — Survivor Week 1; London 4 / Pickens 5 / Fannin 5; off the bus
Aga’s top-3 (Ultron) — Chase 3 / Cook 10 / Loveland 0 (plus Garrett 0)
Eddies’ TE tax — Gesicki 23 vs Warren 12 + Pitts 0
The Host’s Waddle — started flex, scored 1
Dongers 246.5 — lost a game they thought they’d already won

matchups.blurb: Chase didn’t win Week 1 so much as commit a hate crime against the format. While half the league was still arguing about projections, TTAB put **Josh Allen (45), Christian Watson (44), Ashton Jeanty (41), and Zack Baun (35)** on the same card and printed a **315** kitty that made 250 look quaint. That’s not a hot streak — that’s four players who would’ve been a respectable team by themselves wearing one jersey. Ryan Towner’s Slumlords climbed from the early wreckage to **176.5** after Monday and still finished dead last: Gibbs’ **42** was a lighthouse in a fog of **Drake London 4, George Pickens 5, and Harold Fannin 5**. Survivor doesn’t care that you “fought back.” Off the bus. Juice: the nuclear four and a league-high water mark. Junk: a Gibbs 42 in a funeral; London/Pickens/Fannin quiet hours.

Bill brought **241** to a gunfight and still left with an L — and the TE board was a personal foul. Luke’s Saltese closed it **255–241**, fourteen points that will live rent-free next to the “all-time wins, zero rings” plaque. The humiliation wasn’t even the margin; it was the position battle. Luke started **Mike Gesicki for 23**. Bill started his high-draft-capital room and got **Tyler Warren 12** plus **Kyle Pitts 0** in the flex, with Brock Bowers riding pine for another zero. Gesicki alone outscored Warren and smoked the combined Warren+Pitts stack **23–12** — a no-name TE winning the week against a “premium” room. That’s how you go 0-1 with a roster that was supposed to bully people at the position. Juice: Saltese finishing the job; Gesicki’s 23. Junk: Bill’s TE tax, Pitts’ zero, 241 as a losing score.

Tim’s Divers dropped a clean **258.5** and reminded the dual-era champ that Week 1 doesn’t care about your résumé. The engine was the **Swift / Lamar / JJ** stack doing adult work while the rest of the board finished the job Monday made honest. Kyle’s Doubtpfizer landed at **237** — not a collapse into oblivion, just ugly-adjacent for a franchise that usually loses cute. And then there’s the chip you don’t cash: **Brian Burns started for 4**, which is not how “safe” DL is supposed to look on a losing card. Divers win, doubt deferred. Juice: Divers’ skill stack closing the week. Junk: Burns’ four-point apology.

matchups.scoreline: Valley Old Goats 254, Newman Lake Sleep Paralysis Demons 221
matchups.blurb: Heff’s Goats turned an early knife fight into a **254–221** statement after Monday, and the engine was borderline unfair. **T.J. Watt dropped 52** — a half-century on IDP — while **Derrick Henry stamped 43** like the ground still owed him money. Rymo’s SPD’s answered with real juice from Flowers and Hurts, then watched the alphas ghost the assignment: **A.J. Brown 5** and **Davante Adams 5** as starters. That’s ten combined from two WR1s while Watt alone outscored both of them by a career. 221 is a fine score in most leagues. Here it’s a handshake and a ‘tough one.’ Juice: Watt’s 52 and Henry’s 43. Junk: Brown + Adams totaling a single good TE game.

Jesse’s LAB posted **246** and made it look like a plan. Kellen “the Host” Olson’s Pocket finished **216.5** after selling Bo Nix for $10 FAAB and handing Goff the keys — a transaction that already had the group chat warming up. Then Monday delivered the roast that writes itself: **Jaylen Waddle started in the flex for 1 point.** One. The Host’s featured WR put up a single on fantasy TV and the board still had the nerve to look surprised at 216.5. Hosting duties that didn’t include actual receiving yards. Juice: LAB’s 246. Junk: Waddle’s 1; the Nix-for-FAAB hangover.

THE flip — and **Jacob Crisp’s first Wheels Up victory**. Rookie season, Week 1, Monday night heist: Hyper went from a **202.5** loss to a **259.5** win and stole Gavin’s board while the league was already writing Dongers’ win tweet. **Kenneth Walker III dropped 48** as the lead actor while the rest of the Hyper lineup finally showed up for the new franchise’s first column in the W. Dongers still hit **246.5** with Bijan and Olave at **34** each — a perfectly respectable losing score in this format’s cruel new math — and somehow lost a game they thought they’d already won. First wins don’t come prettier than a Monday erasure. Juice: Jacob’s first W; Walker’s 48; the 57-point Monday swing. Junk: 246.5 tasting like a losing score.
